creator: 苗穂工房 (naeboworks)
title: 北海道廃線路線図 — eight regional KML datasets outside Hokkaido
attribution: 北海道廃線路線図 © 2007–2026 苗穂工房 (naeboworks); mapped from GSI Japan aerial photographs (CC BY 4.0).
changes: Converted KML to GeoJSON; kept explicit closed/converted markers and the creator's former railway paths.
Excluded active markers, unbuilt Ohma/Yobuko/Yusubaru paths and three Yobuko construction/planned-site markers.
Retained the former operated Menuma station; cut the Tobu Kumagaya path at its source station location, removing its never-opened northern continuation.
No missing route connection, operation date or station position was inferred; no source station was moved.

status_evidence.purpose: Kumagaya municipal museum distinguishes the never-opened second phase from the former passenger railway terminating at Menuma.
Creator's legend distinguishes active, closed-line and earlier-closed station markers.

limits: All-era approximate reconstruction, not a single synchronized historical snapshot.
Inherits creator coverage and station-position caveats; not an exhaustive historical inventory.
Route path counts include sections and sidings; point counts are source objects, not unique public passenger stations.
Dataset remains a distinct CC BY 4.0 component; application and OSM licenses do not replace it.
Source Wikipedia links retained; linked article prose was not imported.
